items.title: Carrington makes 'white privilege' post after ejection
items.summary: Chicago Sky guard DiJonai Carrington is ejected from her side's defeat by Indiana Fever for committing a hard foul, before taking to social media to post "white privilege".

items.title: Scott and Antony sent off in pre-season friendly
items.summary: Bournemouth's Alex Scott and Real Betis' Antony are sent off after a confrontation during a friendly match in Seville, which ended in a 2-2 draw.
